```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 04_variability_average_deviations
title: >
  Average of Deviations
questions:
  - id: average_deviations
    type: free-response
    prompt: >
      Why can we not simply average the raw deviations from the mean to measure
      variability?
    answer: >
      The raw deviations from the mean always sum to zero because the mean is the
      balance point of the distribution.
    explanation: >
      To measure typical distance from the mean, we need to stop positive and
      negative deviations from canceling out. Squaring deviations is the usual
      solution.
```
